---
title: "Normal Distribution Exploration"
format: html
editor: visual
---


```{r}
## reading in data
library(readr)
Tremblant1 <- read_csv("emiliaagostinelli/normal_distribution_module/Tremblant1.csv")
```


```{r}
## creating a variable for difference in run time between the 2 runs
diff <- Tremblant1$Run1_Time - Tremblant1$Run2_Time
```

```{r}
## looking at a histogram to see how run time differences are distributed
hist(diff)
## appears normally distributed
```

```{r}
## does this hold true for other races?
## look at data from another women's World Cup GS race at Copper Mtn. this year
Copper <- read.csv("emiliaagostinelli/normal_distribution_module/Copper.csv")
```

```{r}
## creating a diff variable for Copper and looking at a histogram
copper_diff <- Copper$Run1_Time - Copper$Run2_Time
hist(copper_diff)
## see a hump in the -0.5 to -1.0 range - unsure if this is concerning
```
